item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a single 2024 source that bundles all program elements into one integrated implementation blueprint. The evidence is distributed across budgets, speeches, appointment records, transparency reforms, and institutional reviews. The weak point is not absence of plans; it is late-2024 implementation continuity after the coalition broke.","evidence":[{"title":"Whole-of-government security strategy with institutional design","publisher":"Federal Government","date":"14 Jun 2023, operative in 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/aktuelles/national-security-strategy-2196356","summary":"Scholz’s National Security Strategy is a systematic all-of-government framework covering diplomacy, police, civil protection, cyber security, supply chains, and pandemic prevention. This translates strategy into institutional structure and planning, not just rhetoric.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.1","1B.3"]},{"title":"Budget package with 49 concrete measures","publisher":"Federal Government","date":"5 Jul 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/budget-2025-2298116","summary":"Scholz tied the budget to a jointly negotiated 49-measure package on modernization, infrastructure, tax relief, social housing, renewables, and growth. That is strong evidence of a program translated into a concrete policy plan.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.1","1B.4"]},{"title":"Fiscal discipline plus investment rule","publisher":"Federal Government","date":"24 Apr 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/aktuelles/stable-financial-policy-2273918","summary":"The government said fiscal policy was moving back toward debt-brake compliance while preserving high investment and raising growth potential. That is a specific macro-policy framework with clear constraints and priorities.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.1","1B.4"]},{"title":"AI and 5G timetables","publisher":"Bundesregierung","date":"5 Sep 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/service/newsletter-und-abos/bulletin/rede-von-bundeskanzler-olaf-scholz-2307122","summary":"Scholz linked AI regulation and 5G security to safer investment conditions and fixed timetables for removing risky components. This is direct evidence of translating strategy into timelines and enforcement-like regulatory sequencing.","question_ids":["8B.2","1B.4"]},{"title":"Executive-footprint transparency reform","publisher":"Bundesregierung","date":"6 Mar 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/aktuelles/bundeskabinett-ergebnisse-2263572","summary":"The cabinet adopted the “executive footprint” and “synopsis” to improve traceability of draft laws and outside influence. That is an institutional mechanism, not just a promise.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.9","7B.10"]},{"title":"Disclosure expansion in the lobby register","publisher":"Deutscher Bundestag","date":"1 Mar 2024","url":"https://www.bundestag.de/parlament/lobbyregister/pm-240301-nl-992030","summary":"Parliament broadened disclosure on rulemaking, financing sources, and revolving-door ties. This is a concrete accountability institution that makes the governing program more enforceable and auditable.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.9"]},{"title":"Technocratic finance appointment","publisher":"Bundespräsident","date":"7 Nov 2024","url":"https://www.bundespraesident.de/SharedDocs/Termine/DE/Frank-Walter-Steinmeier/2024/11/241107-Entlassungen-Ernennung-Minister.html","summary":"Kukies was formally appointed on Scholz’s proposal under Article 64 after Lindner’s dismissal. That shows Scholz translating the crisis into an institutional staffing decision rather than ad hoc improvisation.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.9"]},{"title":"Kukies as competence-first appointee","publisher":"Bundesministerium der Finanzen","date":"21 Nov 2024","url":"https://www.bundesfinanzministerium.de/Monatsberichte/Ausgabe/2024/11/Kapitel/kapitel-2-interview.html","summary":"The finance ministry described Kukies as a deeply experienced policy professional with finance, Chancellery, G7/G20, and private-sector experience. This supports a program-to-appointment link based on execution capacity.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.9"]},{"title":"Social-policy priorities embedded in the budget","publisher":"Bundesregierung","date":"31 Jan 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/service/newsletter-und-abos/bulletin/bundeskanzler-haushalt-2257440","summary":"Scholz tied the budget to Bürgergeld, Wohngeld, child benefit, the child supplement, and lower social contributions for low earners. That is a concrete budget channel for a stated social program.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.1","1B.4"]},{"title":"Bundeswehr capability build-up under a special fund","publisher":"Bundesregierung","date":"6 Sep 2023, operative in 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/service/newsletter-und-abos/bulletin/rede-von-bundeskanzler-olaf-scholz-2166814","summary":"Scholz said the 100 billion euro special fund should create a durable shift in Bundeswehr capabilities and be invested sustainably in equipment, ammunition, training, and personnel. That is an explicit budget-to-capabilities translation.","question_ids":["8B.2","1B.3","1B.4"]},{"title":"Formal review of Bundeswehr missions","publisher":"Federal Foreign Office / Federal Ministry of Defence","date":"26 Jun 2024","url":"https://www.auswaertiges-amt.de/en/newsroom/news/2664958-2664958","summary":"The government carried out a first overarching evaluation of seven missions using uniform criteria and identified improvement needs, including better civilian-military coordination and more realistic goals. That is a concrete institutional review and correction mechanism.","question_ids":["8B.2","1B.3","1B.8"]},{"title":"Public accountability around Taurus decision","publisher":"Bundesregierung","date":"4 Mar 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-fr/service/archives/chancelier-questions-2024-2265010","summary":"Scholz publicly explained the Taurus refusal as a boundary against German military involvement. This is evidence of translating a strategy into a stated policy rule and communicating the tradeoff openly.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.8","7B.10"]},{"title":"Parliamentary record of the Taurus rationale","publisher":"Deutscher Bundestag","date":"13 Mar 2024","url":"https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2024/kw11-de-regierungsbefragung-991060","summary":"Scholz repeated the Taurus rationale in the Bundestag, showing he was willing to put the decision on the record and defend it in the formal institution. That is a real mechanism of political implementation and scrutiny.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.8","7B.10"]},{"title":"Coalition collapse undercut implementation capacity","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"6 Nov 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/explainergerman-coalition-collapses-what-comes-next-3706936","summary":"Firing Lindner collapsed the coalition and triggered political chaos. This does not negate the existence of a program, but it shows the program’s implementation machinery failed late in the year.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"Year-end confidence loss ended the policy window","publisher":"Deutscher Bundestag","date":"16 Dec 2024","url":"https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2024/kw47-vertrauensfrage-1030198","summary":"Parliament withdrew confidence and opened the way for snap elections. That is strong evidence that program execution was cut short before full consolidation.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"Implementation questioned in parliament","publisher":"Deutscher Bundestag","date":"17 Dec 2024","url":"https://www.bundestag.de/presse/hib/kurzmeldungen-1034192","summary":"Parliament was still asking how many of the 49 measures were fully implemented and what growth effect to expect. This shows the plan existed, but execution remained uncertain.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"Critics called the agenda slogan-heavy","publisher":"Deutscher Bundestag","date":"19 Dec 2024","url":"https://www.bundestag.de/presse/hib/kurzmeldungen-1034880","summary":"CDU/CSU said the government relied on “through-put slogans” and ideologically framed planning. That is only criticism, but it is direct evidence that the program was contested as insufficiently operationalized.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"Confidential 5G process weakened transparency","publisher":"Reuters via onvista","date":"23 May 2024","url":"https://www.onvista.de/news/2024/05-23-bericht-regierung-vertagt-entscheidung-ueber-strengere-vorschriften-im-5g-netz-0-20-26275293","summary":"The 5G decision was handled in confidential interministerial talks and ministries declined public comment. The policy direction was clear, but the process was not fully open in real time.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.10"]},{"title":"BND oversight remained too weak","publisher":"Bundesverfassungsgericht","date":"8 Nov 2024","url":"https://www.bundesverfassungsgericht.de/SharedDocs/Pressemitteilungen/EN/2024/bvg24-093.html","summary":"The Court found parts of the BND surveillance framework unconstitutional and said oversight was inadequate. That is a real limit on the reliability of enforcement and control institutions under the government.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.10"]},{"title":"Warburg/Cum-Ex inquiry remained unresolved","publisher":"tagesschau.de","date":"5 Dec 2024","url":"https://www.tagesschau.de/investigativ/ndr-wdr/cum-ex-scholz-untersuchungsausschuss-100.html","summary":"The report says the inquiry remained active and contentious, with unresolved questions about political influence and Scholz’s role. That weakens confidence that the governing program was fully cleanly implemented through accountable institutions.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.10"]}]}
